## Checklist

- [ ] `gofmt -l .` prints nothing
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes
- [ ] `go test ./...` passes
- [ ] Behavior of `keygen`/`encrypt`/`decrypt` is unchanged (or the change is
      intentional and documented)
- [ ] No new dependencies, or the reason is explained
- [ ] No secrets, keys or generated ciphertext are included
- [ ] Documentation and translations updated if user-facing text changed
